summary: Switch between enabled Tailscale and Fabric routes with st fleet transports prefer

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes. Preference publishes existing endpoints through the current fleet endpoint API.

schema.detail: Reorders the existing fleet.toml transports list; no new fields or schema changes.

rules.detail: Membership, trust and transport exposure authority are unchanged. Only enabled transports can be preferred.

compatibility.detail: Existing readers already honor transport order. Add and remove commands retain their behavior.

downtime.detail: Choosing a different preference refreshes installed daemon and replication-worker services, as existing transport changes do. An already-first transport does not restart services.

manual.detail: No upgrade action required. Use st fleet transports prefer tailscale or st fleet transports prefer fabric on each member. With --no-service, restart both st3 daemon and st3 replication-worker as instructed.

recovery.detail: Run the same command with the other enabled transport to restore its priority. No exposure is added or removed.
